_comment: Each shape draws from its own feeds. Selection is per-PROFILE, not per-shape: a capped profile (budget != null) needs a ranking/filter method suited to a slot-limited consumer, while the full/uncapped profile for the same shape should generally use 'none' (raw validated addresses, no aggregation or geographic filtering) since those constraints exist because of the slot budget, not the shape itself. See AGENTS.md section 2 for the measurements behind each choice.

feeds.name: ipsum-level6
feeds.note: Level 6 = flagged by >=6 independent blocklists. Matches what's live in production today; do not lower without re-reading AGENTS.md section 2's reasoning for why the botnet shape needs the highest confidence tier, not the broadest one.
